results.title: SSO and login problems
results.content: For SSO failures check that the identity provider certificate has not expired and that the user is assigned to the app. For password resets use the Forgot password link; reset emails arrive within 5 minutes.

results.title: Error 500 or service unavailable
results.content: A 500 error means a server-side failure. First check whether it is isolated: try another network, browser or user. If several users or browsers see the same error, treat it as a possible service incident and escalate to Incident Response immediately. Do not ask the customer to keep retrying.

results.title: System Default theme does not follow my operating system
results.content: System Default follows the operating system appearance in app version 5.3 and later. On older versions it always shows Light. Update the app or hard-refresh the web app, then switch to Light and back to System Default. If it still does not follow the OS after updating, report it to Technical Support with the app version.

results.title: Duplicate, pending or unexpected charges and refunds
results.content: A pending charge is a card authorization hold. Holds that never convert to a payment usually drop off the statement within 3-7 business days. Captured duplicate charges must be reviewed by the Billing team, who can refund them (refunds take 5-10 business days to reach the card). Support chat cannot issue refunds or promise refund timing. Customers who open a bank dispute may have their account restricted while it is open.

results.title: Payment failed when upgrading to Pro
results.content: Upgrade payments can fail because the card was declined, 3-D Secure verification was not completed, or the bank blocked an international charge. Ask the customer to retry once with a card that has 3-D Secure enabled. If a charge appears on the bank statement but the plan did not change, do not retry again: see KB-102 and KB-103.

results.title: Error 500 or service unavailable
results.content: A 500 error means a server-side failure. First check whether it is isolated: try another network, browser or user. If several users or browsers see the same error, treat it as a possible service incident and escalate to Incident Response immediately. Do not ask the customer to keep retrying.
